detail.description:
Location

MENA Plaza Hotel Albarsha Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 20 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. The hotel cafe is a nice place to have a snack. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone for free.

If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone. The beauty and wellness services: a sauna. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center and a gym. Tourists who can’t live without swimming will appreciate an outdoor pool.

For business meetings, there is a conference hall. If you want to make your journey even more comfortable, you can order a transfer. Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. Additional services that the hotel offers to its guests: a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, a safe-deposit box and a concierge.

The staff of the hotel will be happy to talk to you in English.

Room amenities

In the room, for you, there is a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

MENA Plaza Hotel Albarsha Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 20 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. The hotel cafe is a nice place to have a snack. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone for free.

If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone. The beauty and wellness services: a sauna. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center and a gym. Tourists who can’t live without swimming will appreciate an outdoor pool.

For business meetings, there is a conference hall. If you want to make your journey even more comfortable, you can order a transfer. Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. Additional services that the hotel offers to its guests: a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, a safe-deposit box and a concierge.

The staff of the hotel will be happy to talk to you in English.

Room amenities

In the room, for you, there is a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.
